# Go and the prototype alternate on one project: each reads what the other wrote, including
# the hashes that tie the spec review to the exact text it judged (non-ASCII on purpose).
% init --name "Écrans"
> for k in functional architecture stack security; do printf '# %s — écrit\n\nWritten.\n' $k > .lacarta/specs/$k.md; done
> printf 'Fine.\n' > review.md
$ phase add --title "Écrans – UI" --goal "Ça marche" --scope "Liste « factures »" --covers FR-1
% phase add --title "Export 📄" --goal "PDF"
% review add --phase spec --type specification --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "Complete"
$ status
$ spec submit functional
% spec submit architecture
$ spec submit stack
% spec submit security
$ plan submit
% answer Q-1 --choice Approve
$ answer Q-2 --choice Approve
% answer Q-3 --choice Approve
$ answer Q-4 --choice Approve
% status
$ answer Q-5 --choice Approve
% status
% phase start 1
$ agent start --role implementation --task "Build « Écrans »" --phase 1
% agent list
$ --agent A-2 ask --title "Couleur ?" --option "Bleu|Calme" --option "Rouge|Vif"
% answer Q-6 --choice Bleu --comment "très bien"
$ wait Q-6
% decisions
$ decisions
